criteria.name: Mermaid Syntax & Render Compliance
criteria.description: The Mermaid diagram must parse without errors using mermaid-cli v10+, render correctly in GitHub-flavored markdown, and escape special characters (e.g., &, <, >) via HTML entities or quotes to prevent parser injection.

criteria.name: C4 Actor & System Completeness
criteria.description: Diagram must explicitly include: User, Plant Tracking System, Hermes Agent (Telegram), Phomemo M120 Printer, Seed Packet Data Source, and Weather Service (conditional). Omission of any required entity or inclusion of undefined actors fails the criterion.

criteria.name: Narrative Structure & PRD Traceability
criteria.description: Document must contain fixed sections: '1. Scope', '2. Assumptions & Constraints', '3. Component Definitions'. Every component in the diagram must be defined in section 3 with a direct mapping to specific PRD requirement IDs. Ambiguous prose is rejected.

criteria.name: Relationship Specification
criteria.description: All diagram connections must include a typed label specifying interaction protocol and directionality (e.g., 'QR Code Scan [User -> System]', 'MQTT Telemetry [System -> Printer]'). Vague verbs like 'uses' or 'talks to' are insufficient.

criteria.name: Markdown Linting & Formatting
criteria.description: File must pass markdownlint with zero warnings. Enforce H1 root heading, H2/H3 hierarchy, consistent 2-space indentation, explicit fenced code blocks tagged with mermaid, and no trailing whitespace or mixed tabs/spaces.

criteria.name: Adversarial Edge Case Logging
criteria.description: Must explicitly document handling for: 1) Network partition scenarios, 2) Hardware failure (Phomemo offline), 3) Data latency/consistency expectations. Each case must state whether it falls in or out of C1 scope.
